title: 航空複材自動鋪絲
summary: 以自動鋪絲的窄束轉向與曲面覆蓋，區分路徑誤差、gap、overlap及局部皺摺；僅做幾何和模型練習。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Use narrow-tow steering and surface coverage to distinguish path error, gaps, overlaps and local wrinkles solely through geometry and model exercises. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 纖維方向與性能敏感度：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Fibre direction and property sensitivity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 纖維方向與性能敏感度 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Fibre direction and property sensitivity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 沿纖維等應變的混合法則以體積分率加權模數；轉向或橫向受力需不同本構模型。
steps.instructionEn: The longitudinal iso-strain rule of mixtures weights moduli by volume fraction; off-axis or transverse loading requires a different constitutive model.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非航空複材自動鋪絲實際性能或製程：Ef=230 GPa，Em=3 GPa，Vf=0.60。式 E1=VfEf+(1−Vf)Em，基準結果 139.2 GPa。適用條件：理想單向、完全黏結且無孔隙，非完整航空鋪層剛性。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Aerospace automated fiber placement: Ef=230 GPa, Em=3 GPa and fibre volume fraction Vf=0.60. Formula E1=VfEf+(1−Vf)Em gives 139.2 GPa. Conditions: Ideal unidirectional, perfectly bonded and void-free material; not a complete aircraft laminate stiffness.
steps.failure: 把E1用在所有方向會高估橫向與剪切剛性。
steps.failureEn: Using E1 in every direction overestimates transverse and shear stiffness.
steps.check: 比較沿纖維與橫向虛擬拉伸曲線，將鋪層角度和試片方向寫入檔名。
steps.checkEn: Compare longitudinal and transverse virtual tensile curves and encode ply angle and coupon orientation in filenames.

knowledge.title: 纖維方向與性能敏感度
knowledge.text: 沿纖維等應變的混合法則以體積分率加權模數；轉向或橫向受力需不同本構模型。
knowledge.textEn: The longitudinal iso-strain rule of mixtures weights moduli by volume fraction; off-axis or transverse loading requires a different constitutive model.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再僅把Vf改成0.55；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 139.2 改為 127.85 GPa。在算式區重算並記下對「纖維方向與性能敏感度」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only Vf to 0.55, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 139.2 to 127.85 GPa. Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Fibre direction and property sensitivity, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

steps.title: 窄束路徑與最大偏差：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Narrow-tow paths and maximum error: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 窄束路徑與最大偏差 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Narrow-tow paths and maximum error and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 窄絲束可沿曲面轉向，但局部路徑偏差、間隙及皺摺需分別量測；均方誤差不能替代最大缺陷。
steps.instructionEn: Narrow tows can steer over a surface, but path error, gap and wrinkle require separate measurement; RMS error does not replace worst-defect assessment.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非航空複材自動鋪絲實際性能或製程：三點路徑偏差e=[0.2,−0.1,0.3] mm。式 RMS=√[(Σei²)/3]，基準結果 0.21602469 mm。適用條件：離散幾何示例，不是驗收門檻；最大局部缺陷仍須獨立記錄。 長度若以m算出，乘1000轉mm。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Aerospace automated fiber placement: Three path errors e=[0.2,-0.1,0.3] mm. Formula RMS=√[(Σei²)/3] gives 0.21602469 mm. Conditions: Discrete geometry example, not an acceptance threshold; the worst local defect remains a separate record. Multiply a result in metres by 1000 to report millimetres.
steps.failure: 取平均帶正負號誤差會讓左右偏差互相抵消。
steps.failureEn: A signed mean cancels left and right errors.
steps.check: 將每條絲束的中心線與設計路徑疊圖，同時報告RMS及最大偏差。
steps.checkEn: Overlay tow centreline and design path and report both RMS and maximum error.

knowledge.textEn: Narrow tows can steer over a surface, but path error, gap and wrinkle require separate measurement; RMS error does not replace worst-defect assessment.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再只把第三點改成0.6 mm；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 0.21602469 改為 0.36968455 mm。在算式區重算並記下對「窄束路徑與最大偏差」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only the third error to 0.6 mm, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 0.21602469 to 0.36968455 mm. Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Narrow-tow paths and maximum error, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.
